render_scalar: local binary32 after double transform and origin subtraction

document.job: document_id + epoch + base_revision + generation; reject on mismatch/cancel
document.snapshot: immutable root and spatial index at same revision; retain referenced assets

persistence.save: one fixed snapshot r; only clear dirty if current epoch and revision still match
persistence.recovery: previous or newly committed valid file; partial file never success
persistence.durability: atomic replace alone does not prove power-loss durability

production.topology: correct on fixture subset or explicit diagnostic; preserve source curves
production.preview: never overwrite source or become manufacturing output

worker.permissions: host-enforced AppContainer/resource limits; process separation alone is not containment

build.root: leader bootstrap CMake may read a lane source root via PIKDRAW_SPIKE_SOURCE_ROOT
build.outputs: each lane uses its own ignored out/build directory; shared root/contracts are leader-owned

evidence.mandatory: all mandatory gates need exact integrated SHA, commands/raw data, fixtures and independent reviewer; no automatic promotion from process exit 0
